# `get_calib_param`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Read the stored calibration frame count for a frame type.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (the handler itself only reads state; the grade reflects the shared diagnostic log writes made by every full call) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, get_calib_param @0xd2c20, GetCalibrateParam @0x1937e0 |

Returns the stored calibration integer for the selected type as a bare integer result (no object). Interpreted as a frame count (INFERRED); units and ranges are unresolved.

Side effects: None beyond the shared diagnostic log writes. Reads a shared integer.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"get_calib_param"`. [READ] |
| `params` | any | no | - | Required frame-type selector: a string (dark, bias or flat), or an array whose first element is that string. Absent, null, empty array or non-string gives 105; an object is not accepted. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 105 | Selector missing, null, empty array or not a string | `expected string param` |
| 209 | Unknown or light type | `invalid value` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

## Example

Request, dark:

```json
{"id":47,"method":"get_calib_param","params":"dark"}
```

Request, positional - Array form:

```json
{"id":48,"method":"get_calib_param","params":["bias"]}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"get_calib_param","result":20,"code":0,"id":47}
```
